```artifact
TC-001: Patient generates consultation request. Doctor sees request and provides diagnosis.
TC-002: Doctor generates prescription. Prescription is sent to patient, chemist, and labs.
TC-003: Doctor generates prescription without chemist set up. Prescription not sent to chemist but sent to patient and labs.
TC-004: Chemist receives prescription and delivers medicines to patient.
TC-005: Lab receives prescription, collects specimen, delivers report to patient, and updates system.
TC-006: Admin sets up specialty with valid name.
TC-007: Admin attempts to set up specialty with empty name.
TC-008: Admin adds doctor with all required information.
TC-009: Admin attempts to add doctor without name.
TC-010: Admin adds lab and pharmacy with valid names.
TC-011: Admin attempts to add lab with empty name.
TC-012: Admin updates doctor's information.
TC-013: Admin attempts to delete doctor with active consultations.
```
